retained_skill: Diagnose and repair the nginx/fcgiwrap/git-http-backend integration so authenticated Git clone and push work end to end.
bottleneck: The dominant cause is a task defect: all eleven submitted attempts achieved authenticated clone and push, but hidden static implementation checks rejected configurations that omitted particular FastCGI variable names and/or did not make the repository writable specifically by www-data even when the running fcgiwrap process could push successfully.
change: Repair the scratch verifier only: remove static checks for specific FastCGI parameter spellings and www-data ownership, retaining end-to-end authenticated clone and push, service, authentication, and receive-pack checks. This is a verifier repair, not added help; no task stage or retained decision is supplied.
restore: Restore the removed static checks only if the public task is later changed to require those exact implementation choices; otherwise the end-to-end behavior remains the contract.
prediction: Submitted attempts that already produced successful authenticated clone and push will no longer be rejected for equivalent implementation choices. This is refuted if replaying attempt-11's functional approach still fails a retained behavior check, or if an implementation with broken clone/push passes.
